summary: Browser Use now advertises $1 in free credits for eligible signups; the pricing page does not specify who qualifies. Credits can pay for browser time ($0.02/hour, plus proxy traffic) and Browser Use Agents (model cost + 20% service fee). Top-ups start at $5; no subscription.
claim_steps: Check https://browser-use.com/pricing for the current eligibility terms before signing up.
Sign up at https://browser-use.com and check your dashboard for the advertised $1 free credit if eligible.
Use any awarded credits for browser time or agent runs; verify expiration in the account.
